factChecks.fact: opening ferrite clamp jaw must be clearly visible and open-able around a conductor -- the defining recognition feature
factChecks.note: Yellow clamp jaw clearly visible at the top, unmistakably an opening clamp mechanism.
Body includes rotary function selector, LCD display, and input jacks -- a genuine handheld clamp meter form.

prohibitedChangeChecks.prohibition: do not make one manufacturer's product appearance canonical
prohibitedChangeChecks.note: Generic yellow/black industrial colour scheme, no manufacturer logo.

styleComplianceNotes: White/near-white background (screen/display area is its own small dark LCD, an acceptable narrow exception per the style guide -- the surrounding body is light). Label "CLAMP METER" present.
